notice: Precomputed from real forward passes of GPT-2 small. Regenerate with the script above to reproduce.

demos.title: Induction: repeated sentence
demos.summary: A sentence repeated twice. On the second copy, some heads attend from each token to the token that followed its earlier occurrence.

demos.title: Indirect object identification
demos.summary: The model must predict the name that is not repeated. Compare attention from the final token to both names, and inspect the ablation table.

demos.title: Factual recall: landmark location
demos.summary: A factual completion. Attention to the subject tokens is visible in several heads, but attention alone does not localize where the fact is stored.

demos.title: Pronoun resolution
demos.summary: A Winograd-style sentence. Check which nouns the pronoun 'it' attends to in different heads, and whether the next-token prediction depends on them.

demos.title: Subject–verb agreement
demos.summary: The verb must agree with 'keys', not the closer noun 'cabinet'. Compare the probability of ' are' with ' is' after ablating heads.

demos.title: Code: function body
demos.summary: Python source with a newline and indentation. Inspect how whitespace is tokenized and how the final token attends to the parameter list.
